title: The Archaic Passive in Labour History
goal: I can analyze institutional labor policies, corporate restructuring, and formal employer demands (*munkaköri leírás, munkáltatói önkény, felmondási hullám*).
I can recognise the archaic passive in `-tatik/-tetik` in old laws and factory rules (*követeltetik, tiltatik, elutasíttatott*) and say the same thing in modern Hungarian.
I can tell when a modern text uses the old passive as mock-officialese.
